verdict: COMPLETE - UNCONDITIONAL: three constant-curvature model metrics in polar form dr^2 + j_K(r)^2 g_{S^{n-1}} with the D10 Jacobi solutions; warped-product metric axioms reduced to the D10 ODE conditions; Bishop-Gromov volume comparison at the ODE level proved by derivative sign computation (Wronskian, ratio monotonicity, integral estimate, (V1/V2)' <= 0); model-case Laplacian comparison by explicit radial computation (Delta r = (n-1) j_K'/j_K, hence <=, plus cross-model antitone comparison); axiom cone exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; no sorry/axiom/unsafe/native_decide/proof_wanted.

definitions.polarMetric: fun n j r u v => u.1 * v.1 + j r ^ 2 * inner R u.2 v.2   -- polar metric dr^2 + j(r)^2 g on R x EuclideanSpace R (Fin (n-1))
definitions.modelSphereMetric: polarMetric n (jacobiSolSphere K) r   -- spherical space form, K > 0
definitions.modelFlatMetric: polarMetric n jacobiSolFlat r   -- Euclidean space, K = 0
definitions.modelHyperbolicMetric: polarMetric n (jacobiSolHyperbolic K) r   -- hyperbolic space form, K < 0
definitions.WarpedProductModel: fun K j => HasNormalizedInitial j and SolvesJacobiODE K j   -- constant-curvature model axioms = D10 conditions
definitions.ballVolume: fun n K r => integral t in 0..r, jacobiSol K t ^ (n - 1)   -- unnormalised model ball volume
definitions.wronskian: fun K1 K2 t => jacobiDeriv K1 t * jacobiSol K2 t - jacobiSol K1 t * jacobiDeriv K2 t
definitions.radialLaplacian: fun n j f r => deriv (deriv f) r + ((n - 1 : N) : R) * deriv j r / j r * deriv f r
definitions.divergenceLaplacian: fun n j f r => deriv (fun s => j s ^ (n - 1) * deriv f s) r / j r ^ (n - 1)

claims.requirement: define the three constant-curvature model metrics in polar form dr^2 + j_K(r)^2 g_{S^{n-1}} with the D10 Jacobi solutions j_K; verify the warped-product metric axioms reduce to the ODE conditions already proved
claims.statement: polarMetric n j r is the symmetric, bilinear, positive-definite-off-the-pole form u1*v1 + j(r)^2 <u2,v2>; the three model metrics insert the D10 warps sin(sqrt K r)/sqrt K, r, sinh(sqrt(-K) r)/sqrt(-K); WarpedProductModel K j = (j 0 = 0 and j' 0 = 1) and (forall t, j'' t + K j t = 0), and for every K the D10 jacobiSol (and each branch on its sign range) satisfies it.
claims.hypotheses: warpedProductModel_jacobiSolSphere: 0 < K; warpedProductModel_jacobiSolHyperbolic: K < 0; warpedProductModel_jacobiSolFlat and warpedProductModel_jacobiSol: none
claims.proof: the reduction is literal: the proof terms are exactly the D10 theorems jacobiSol…_hasNormalizedInitial and jacobiSol…_solvesJacobiODE; positive definiteness uses the D10 sign lemmas jacobiSolSphere_pos / sinh positivity and inner_self_eq_zero.

claims.requirement: prove unconditionally the Bishop-Gromov volume comparison at the ODE level: r -> vol(B_K(r))/vol(B_K^model(r)) is monotone non-increasing, via derivative sign computation
claims.statement: bishopGromov_volume_comparison : K2 <= K1, 0 < r1 <= r2, (0 < K1 -> r2 <= pi / sqrt K1) ==> ballVolume n K1 r2 / ballVolume n K2 r2 <= ballVolume n K1 r1 / ballVolume n K2 r1
claims.hypotheses: K2 <= K1; 0 < r1 <= r2; first-zero restriction r2 <= pi/sqrt K1 only when K1 > 0 (vacuous for K1 <= 0); no comparison theorem assumed
claims.proof: derivative sign computation: (1) Wronskian W' = (K2-K1) j1 j2 <= 0, W 0 = 0 => W <= 0 (antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos); (2) (j1/j2)' = W/j2^2 <= 0 => ratio antitone, cross-multiplied j1(t) j2(r) >= j1(r) j2(t) incl. endpoints t = 0, r = pi/sqrt K1; (3) pow (n-1) (pow_le_pow_left_0) + integrate (integral_mono_on) => j1(r)^(n-1) V2(r) <= V1(r) j2(r)^(n-1); (4) FTC (integral_hasDerivAt_right) gives V_K' = j_K^(n-1), so (V1/V2)' = (j1^(n-1) V2 - V1 j2^(n-1))/V2^2 <= 0; antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos on the closed interval [r1, r2] yields the two-point statement including the endpoint r2 = pi/sqrt K1.

claims.requirement: prove the Laplacian comparison Delta r <= (n-1) j_K'(r)/j_K(r) in the model case (explicit radial computation, unconditional)
claims.statement: radialLaplacian n j f r = f''(r) + ((n-1)/1 * j'(r)/j(r)) * f'(r) equals the divergence form (j^(n-1) f')'/j^(n-1) (chain rule, 2 <= n); for f = id: Delta r = (n-1) j_K'(r)/j_K(r) = (n-1) jacobiDeriv K r / jacobiSol K r for each explicit D10 branch; hence laplacianComparison_model : radialLaplacian n (jacobiSol K) id r <= (n-1) jacobiDeriv K r / jacobiSol K r unconditionally; cross-model: K2 <= K1 => Delta_{K1} r <= Delta_{K2} r (0 < r before the first zero of j_{K1}).
claims.hypotheses: laplacianComparison_model: none (equality, unconditional); divergenceLaplacian_eq_radialLaplacian: 2 <= n, j r /= 0, differentiability; cross-model comparison: 0 < r and 0 < K1 -> r < pi/sqrt K1
claims.proof: explicit radial computation: HasDerivAt.pow for (j^(n-1))' = (n-1) j^(n-2) j' and product rule give the divergence derivative, then cancellation j^(n-1) = j * j^(n-2) (field_simp); deriv_id gives Delta(id) = (n-1) j'/j; the cross-model comparison divides the Wronskian inequality j1' j2 <= j1 j2' by the positive j1 j2.
